lesson.title: 6.3 Going to the bakery to buy bread
lesson.unit_outcome: Ask whether a place is near, say how people go to work and why they go somewhere, find a platform or gate, pack for a trip, find places on a street, follow and ask for directions, ask permission, buy tickets, understand delays and check in at a hotel.
lesson.lesson_title: Going to the bakery to buy bread
lesson.sub_lesson_title: Going to the bakery to buy bread
lesson.goal: Say where someone is going and what for with to + a verb (Ana is going to the bakery to buy bread.).
lesson.grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 6.3 Where Are You Going?: A1 asks and says where someone is going; A1+ 6.3 adds what for, with to + a verb after the place (I'm going to the pool to swim.). The new items are to buy, to get and to swim as the first purposes, then to run and to read with known verbs. Each photo shows the person at the place doing the thing they go there for: Ana buying bread, Luis taking money from the bank's cash machine, Diego with a book in the bookstore, Ana in the pool (A1+ 1.3), Sofia and Luis running in the park (A1+ 1.3), the children reading in A1 6's library.
lesson.prerequisite: A1 6.3 Where are you going?; A1+ 6.1 bakery and bookstore; A1 buy, money, bread, swim, run, read.
lesson.speaking_outcome: Say to as a weak tuh before the verb: tuh-BUY, tuh-GET. Do not require native-like speed.
